note: Clip slots for content-trailer-2027.js (the 2027 season trailer, 140 bpm). One entry per shot, in film order. ss = start second in the source, dur = seconds on screen (already set from the beats: 1 beat .5, 2 beats .95, 4 beats 1.8, 8 beats 3.55, 12 beats 5.25), cw = crop width in source pixels (zoom), speed = slow motion, track = keep the aircraft centred, dust = sensor dust removal on plain sky, sound = roar (engine up, music ducked), quiet or rumble, mute = no engine sound. Entries with an empty src still need a clip: 'pick' says what the shot is for. Jack asked for clips already used in the Cosford, Eastbourne, Duxford and Shuttleworth trailers, because they are known good. Give each picked clip its own root if it is not under the main root. Video only, no photos. Check every clip sheet for dust spots, dark shapes, soft focus, faces looking at the camera and aircraft cut off.
